excerpt.zh: 我们在[tiyanki_kill_system.GetName]星系中成功捕杀了一些野生缇扬奇。我方舰队用激光切割以从巨型缇扬奇的尸体内提取矿物和资源。
excerpt.en: We have successfully hunted down and killed some wild Tiyanki in the [tiyanki_kill_system.GetName] system. Our fleet has used laser cutters to extract materials and resources from the massive Tiyanki remains.
